part.text: The current generator deletes `dist` on every build and plugins are responsible for all page rendering, so incremental mode must preserve existing outputs and reconstruct skipped pages for `afterBuild` (especially the generated index). I’ll keep the existing plugin hook sequence, add an opt-in incremental/clean path, and store enough page metadata plus rendered HTML in the output manifest to avoid invoking page hooks for unchanged pages.
